steps.title: Prepare 1 M silver nitrate solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8.75 g silver nitrate powder in Milli‑Q water and bring the final volume to 50 mL; store at room temperature protected from light and adjust volume as needed for the number of slides.

steps.title: Prepare 1 % formic acid solution
steps.instruction: Mix 0.568 mL 88 % formic acid with 49.432 mL Milli‑Q water to a final volume of 50 mL; store at room temperature and adjust volume as needed.

steps.title: Prepare 2 % gelatin‑formic acid solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 g type‑B gelatin to 50 mL of the 1 % formic acid solution, warm in a 37 °C water bath for ~2 h until fully dissolved; store at room temperature. (Alternative formulations: 0.05–1 % gelatin with 0.05–5 % formic acid or 1–2 % gelatin with 0.1–2 % formic acid are acceptable.)

steps.title: Prepare PBS (0.01 M, pH 7.4)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8.006 g NaCl, 0.201 g KCl, 1.419 g Na₂HPO₄, and 0.244 g KH₂PO₄ in Milli‑Q water and bring the volume to 1 L; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Euthanize and disinfect animals
steps.instruction: Euthanize 8‑week‑old male C57BL/6J mice and Sprague‑Dawley rats by CO₂ inhalation, then briefly spray the mouse’s skin with 75 % ethanol for disinfection.

steps.title: Dissect bone and rinse in cold PBS
steps.instruction: Using sterile scissors and forceps, dissect the desired bone (e.g., femur, tibia), remove excess muscle, and rinse the bone in cold PBS to eliminate blood and debris.

steps.title: Fix bones in formalin
steps.instruction: Transfer bones to 10 % neutral buffered formalin (or 4 % PFA) at a volume ten times the bone volume; fix for 24 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rinse bones in Milli‑Q water
steps.instruction: Rinse the fixed bones in Milli‑Q water six times, each rinse lasting 10 min, to remove excess fixative.

steps.title: Decalcify bones in EDTA
steps.instruction: Place bones in 10 % EDTA (pH 7.4) decalcifying solution, change the solution every 3 days, and monitor weekly by gently bending the bones; for 8‑week mouse long bones or comparable samples, typical decalcification time is 4 weeks.

steps.title: Rinse decalcified bones
steps.instruction: After decalcification, rinse the bones in Milli‑Q water six times, each rinse lasting 10 min, to remove residual EDTA.

steps.title: Dehydrate through graded ethanol
steps.instruction: Immerse bones sequentially in 70 % ethanol (1 h), 80 % ethanol (1 h), 90 % ethanol (1 h), then perform three rinses in 100 % ethanol, each rinse lasting 1 h, to achieve complete dehydration.

steps.title: Clear bones in xylene series
steps.instruction: Clear the dehydrated bones in 50 % ethanol/50 % xylene (v/v) for 1 h, followed by two changes of 100 % xylene, each for 1 h.

steps.title: Infiltrate bone with molten paraffin
steps.instruction: Place the cleared bones in molten paraffin at 60 °C, perform three successive changes of paraffin to ensure full infiltration.

steps.title: Embed bone in paraffin molds
steps.instruction: Transfer the infiltrated bones to embedding molds filled with molten paraffin; allow the paraffin to solidify at room temperature for ~1 h.

steps.title: Freeze and detach paraffin blocks
steps.instruction: After solidification, place the molds in a –20 °C freezer for 10 min, then gently detach the paraffin blocks; store blocks at room temperature or 4 °C for at least three years.

steps.title: Section paraffin blocks at 4 µm
steps.instruction: Cut the paraffin blocks into 4 µm thick sections using a microtome and mount the sections onto microscope slides, ensuring even distribution and adherence.

steps.title: Dry sections at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place the slides in a thermoelectric oven set to 37 °C for 1 h to promote adherence of the sections to the slides.

steps.title: Dewax sections at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the slides in a thermoelectric oven at 60 °C for 6 h to remove residual wax and moisture.

steps.title: Store dewaxed sections
steps.instruction: Keep the dewaxed sections at room temperature or 4 °C for long‑term preservation (≥3 years).

steps.title: Deparaffinize sections in xylene
steps.instruction: Immerse the 4 µm sections in xylene for 10 min at room temperature; repeat twice more for a total of three xylene changes.

steps.title: Rehydrate sections through ethanol
steps.instruction: Pass the sections through 100 %, 90 %, 80 %, and 70 % ethanol sequentially, 5 min in each solution.

steps.title: Wash sections with Milli‑Q water
steps.instruction: Wash the rehydrated sections twice with Milli‑Q water (18.2 MΩ·cm) for 5 min each; avoid tap water, PBS, TBS, or saline.

steps.title: Apply silver nitrate staining solution
steps.instruction: Blot excess water from around the tissue (do not touch tissue), place slides flat in a staining box, prepare staining solution immediately (mix 0.2 mL 1 M AgNO₃ solution with 0.1 mL 2 % gelatin‑formic acid solution; volume ratio can be 2:1 or 1:1), keep away from light, and apply to the sections. Incubate either under 254 nm UV light for 60 min or under regular room light for 90 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Terminate staining by washing
steps.instruction: Wash the stained slides twice with Milli‑Q water for 5 min each to remove excess staining solution; avoid tap water, PBS, TBS, or saline.

steps.title: Dehydrate stained sections
steps.instruction: Pass the slides through 70 %, 80 %, 90 %, and 100 % ethanol sequentially, 5 min in each solution.

steps.title: Clear stained sections in xylene
steps.instruction: Immerse the slides in xylene three times, 10 min each, to eliminate ethanol before mounting.

steps.title: Mount sections with neutral balsam
steps.instruction: Apply neutral balsam mounting medium to each section, carefully place a coverslip, and ensure no air bubbles are trapped.

steps.title: Dry mounted slides overnight
steps.instruction: Place the mounted slides in a thermoelectric oven at 37 °C and dry overnight to solidify the mounting medium.

steps.title: Capture images of osteocyte LCS
steps.instruction: Using a high‑resolution optical microscope with a 40× or 100× oil‑immersion objective, acquire 4–5 random fields per slide under consistent lighting and exposure; save images in TIF format with RGB color mode.
